Jordan (Sales): Looping CS + Support on Orchid Therapeutics trial handoff. Dedicated VPC + Okta SSO. Trial is active but they're seeing sporadic embedding failures and latency spikes. Renewal ~11mo out; flagging medium risk until perf/SSO stable.
Priya (CS): Thanks Jordan. Quick ask: who is their technical contact and what tickets exist? Also preferred kickoff window?
Jordan (Sales): CTO contact: lena@orchid.io. Tickets: SUP-4701 (peering), SUP-4702 (embedding failures). They prefer Thurs morning PT for kickoff.
Diego (Support): I'll take SUP-4701 and SUP-4702. First steps: confirm VPC CIDR, peering approvals, and grab failed job logs. Jordan please add infra approver to the tickets.
Jordan (Sales): Added mark_infra@orchid.io to both tickets. CIDR: 10.30.0.0/16. Region: us-east-1.
Lina (Solutions Eng): For latency: propose canary using quantized model and warmed KV cache; seq cap 1024. Need sample prompts and a service key. If p50 < 160ms at their expected peak we should be good; p95 target < 350ms.
Priya (CS): Owners: Priya = CS lead & kickoff; Diego = infra & tickets; Lina = canary/perf; Jordan = sales liaison. Priya will send the calendar invite for Thurs 9:30am PT.
ticket-bot: SUP-4701 created -> assigned to Diego. SUP-4702 created -> assigned to Diego.
Diego (Support): Kicked off peering preflight. ETA 24-48h if approvals go through. Uploaded checklist to SUP-4701.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment started at 1779991150 by lina -> canary-dedicated-quant.
Lina (Solutions Eng): Canary initial run (light load) -> p50=150ms p95=300ms. Will run a peak sim (80rps) and update SUP-4702.
Priya (CS): I'll update account health dashboard (status: onboarding, risk: medium) and include these owners. I'll also send pre-kickoff asks to Lena: approver, SCIM admin, sample embedding job config.
Jordan (Sales): Thanks all. I'll standby for commercial contingencies if more capacity needed post-canary. :thumbsup:
